specimen.method: dark components on foreground outside the dilated reddish body, area in (18, 900) px

measurements.name: focal linear wavelength lambda(k_max)
measurements.method: spatial calibration: (2 pi / k_max) * scale, scale chosen so this equals the slot wavelength
measurements.note: analytical focal wavelength is 2.12 µm by calibration; the numerical Fourier peak is reported separately

measurements.name: numerical Fourier peak wavelength at focal Dv
measurements.method: dominant non-zero mode of the linear-regime field, stopped at std(u)=0.08
measurements.note: value is the measured peak and is not forced equal to the 2.12 µm reference

measurements.name: Pearson r of numerical vs analytical wavelength across Dv sweep
measurements.method: np.corrcoef across the fixed-domain Dv sweep; spectral centroid in cycles [0.30, 0.80]
measurements.source: linear Turing prediction versus Fourier peak

measurements.name: RMSE of numerical vs analytical wavelength
measurements.method: root mean square of (lambda_numerical - lambda_analytical) over the Dv sweep

measurements.name: two-sample KS statistic of numerical vs analytical wavelength sets
measurements.source: same fixed-domain sweep; 0 would mean the two wavelength sets are the same distribution

measurements.name: equal-diffusion ablation amplitude ratio
measurements.method: Du = Dv = 0.40, periodic Schnakenberg, T = 36; pattern must decay
measurements.source: negative control: Turing discriminant fails when Du = Dv

measurements.name: grimshawi stripe coherency minus guttifera spot coherency
measurements.method: saturated fields; grimshawi anisotropy 3.15 versus guttifera isotropy plus sensillum Gaussian
measurements.source: reconstructed chronospecies contrast at 2.12 µm and 0 Ma

measurements.name: heteroneura linear wavelength
measurements.method: k_max at a = 0.24, same Du, Dv, no sensillum Gaussian
measurements.note: reference is the guttifera focal wavelength; the value must differ

measurements.name: grimshawi geometric-mean linear wavelength
measurements.method: k_max with Du and Dv multiplied by sqrt(3.15)

measurements.name: specimen wing-membrane spot count
measurements.method: dark components on foreground outside the dilated reddish body, area in (18, 900) px
measurements.source: Werner et al. 2010 name about 16 wing spots; both wings are in the photograph
measurements.note: pass-1 global dark count was 28; wing mask is not forced to 16

measurements.name: zero-flux control wavelength
measurements.method: explicit reflecting-boundary Schnakenberg, N=48, spectral centroid in the same fixed band
measurements.source: Neumann control against the periodic linear calibration

measurements.name: saturated activator nearest-neighbour spacing
measurements.method: local maxima of the saturated guttifera field, minimum-separation window 0.55 λ
measurements.source: nonlinear spacing versus the linear 2.12 µm calibration

measurements.name: specimen structure-tensor coherency
measurements.method: Sobel structure tensor on the CC BY-SA adult male, masked against the border median
measurements.source: MA Hanson, Wikimedia Commons File:Dguttifera.tif, CC BY-SA 4.0

measurements.name: specimen foreground fraction
measurements.method: pixels whose contrast to the border median exceeds the 45th percentile

measurements.name: specimen dark-blob area coefficient of variation
measurements.method: std/mean of component areas in (20, 800) px
